20 — localStorage origin и отдельный прогресс не изменялись

limitations: Private recovery-v2 empty-store import is verified, but not wired into the production app or a real file-picker flow
Recovery-v2 preserves catalog editions and previous snapshots; separate LEARNING_STORAGE_KEY MIDI progress, its pending journals and MIDI/audio settings are excluded
Before production activation all legacy writers and separate progress transfers need a coordinated contract; no automatic schema1-6 upgrade, merge or overwrite
Canonical byte and pin checks do not authenticate a file publisher; source core null means a missing key because v2 does not encode physical presence of null or undefined
Native two-connection races were tested in one page; real two-tab, maximum-size memory, physical disk-full and hardware power-loss were not tested
Quota failure was injected into a real native transaction; no real browser quota was exhausted
Native hourly timer, service and fresh health receipts were matched before manual jobs; daily and weekly native external triggers remain unobserved
Scheduled restore used the VPS password file; independent DPAPI recovery remains the separate phase18 proof
The selected source checkpoint excludes later final state and receipt documents; no real browser-private data or secrets are in it
Public54/previous53 are unchanged; historical development05 and all eight historical private checkpoints remain separate proofs
Production retention quarantine, final removal, S3 prune, IAM/policy changes and new timers were not performed; complete restic HTTP counts and billing remain unknown
